experiment: E164 — Discourse Forum Engagement Rate Observation
key_findings: Low engagement (zero-reply) fraction is a general property of developer-focused Discourse forums
Kubernetes Discourse unserved fraction (0.722) is lower than Prometheus (0.891) but still fails G3 gate
G1 gate passes (100% topics have view_count > 0) in both Prometheus and Kubernetes
G2 gate passes when classifier covers sufficient population and need fraction ≥ 5%
The view-count principle's G3 gate may need domain-specific adjustment rather than being a universal dysfunction threshold
